ORAL ORDER 1) As recorded in an order dated 01.10.2014, in absence of Appellate Authority as provided under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the Act') present petition came to be filed challenging an order passed by the Adjudicating Officer and Resident Additional Collector,
